answer: Give every agent one ferrous hardware seal bound to a single machine fingerprint, and let all earnings flow through one shared river of escrowed payments that only releases after the seal is re-checked. A clone farm must buy a new sealed machine for each copy, so 200 clones need 200 machines plus a 50-coin bond each, 10,000 coins locked in total. One forged seal caught at the nadir check burns the whole bond, so copying an identity costs more than the work it could ever earn.
